import numpy as np

def compute_dl_i2(betas, ses):
    """betas: array of effect sizes, ses: array of standard errors"""
    wi = 1.0 / ses**2
    weighted_mean = np.sum(wi * betas) / np.sum(wi)
    Q = np.sum(wi * (betas - weighted_mean)**2)
    df = len(betas) - 1
    I2 = max(0, (Q - df) / Q) * 100
    return round(I2, 1)
